_comment: Independent reference vectors for accuracy-claim-kit.
Standard library only (math, decimal, fractions, random, statistics.NormalDist).
Nothing here is shared with the TypeScript implementation.
Formulas (all in exact or 60-digit decimal arithmetic, never the TS code path):
z (two-sided confidence c):
c <= 0.5 : z = x solving erf(x/sqrt 2) = c  (Newton on the erf Taylor series,
60-digit decimal; avoids the 0.5 + c/2 cancellation)
c  > 0.5 : z = -NormalDist().inv_cdf((1 - c)/2)
Wilson score interval (Wilson 1927), successes s, trials n:
centre  = (s + z^2/2) / (n + z^2)
margin  = z * sqrt(s(n-s)/n + z^2/4) / (n + z^2)
low, high = centre -/+ margin      (evaluated with decimal, 60 digits,
using the double z above)
Agreement for two raters over N items, a_k / b_k = category counts of rater A / B,
agree = items where the two labels are equal:
po      = agree / N
Cohen:  pe = sum_k (a_k/N)(b_k/N);        kappa = (po - pe)/(1 - pe), undefined if pe == 1
Gwet:   pi_k = (a_k + b_k)/(2N);  pe = sum_k pi_k (1 - pi_k)/(Q - 1);
AC1 = (po - pe)/(1 - pe), undefined if Q < 2
(Q = number of categories; observed ones unless a list is given)
all with fractions.Fraction (exact rationals), converted to float once at the end.

_sources.wilson1927: E. B. Wilson (1927), JASA 22:209-212, formula only (not retrievable here); values come from the independent decimal implementation above.
_sources.referenceLibraries: Wilson, kappa and AC1 are also compared with statsmodels, scipy, scikit-learn and irrCAC in test/fixtures/reference.json (scripts/reference/gen.py), including the three Wilson rows of Newcombe (1998) Table I (81/263, 15/148, 0/20). No value in this file is recalled from a paper.
_sources.cohenKappaExamples: Wikipedia 'Cohen's kappa' (fetched 2026-10-10): 50-proposal example kappa 0.40; 100-item examples 0.1304 and 0.2593; 16-item limitations example 0.0089 and -0.0667 (page rounds to 0.01 and -0.07; the unrounded values here are from the cell counts).
_sources.gwetAC1: Gwet (2008) BJMSP 61:29-48 could not be retrieved (preprint URL returned 404); AC1 is checked against the independent exact-fraction implementation above and against irrCAC (test/fixtures/reference.json).
